title: Roswell Checkmate
subtitle: Test your understanding of Roswell Checkmate — the 1947 Anakim interdiction that forced solid-state technology into human civilization and compressed the Reset Harvest timeline.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Roswell Checkmate compressed a millennium-long Reset Harvest timeline by forcing the point-contact transistor into public awareness. The same global transistor network the Custodians used for control also carried unredacted truth toward the Great Spiritual Awakening.

questions.question: What was the primary strategic purpose of the 1947 Roswell Checkmate operation?

options.label: A
options.text: The operation was meant to destroy every Grey extraterrestrial craft operating across the solar system in one engagement, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Advanced sensors detected two Grey H1 Orion craft flying a systematic search pattern over New Mexico.

options.label: B
options.text: The operation was a formal peaceful technology-sharing agreement between human governments and the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: It was an intentional military-grade interdiction against hostile H1 Orion Greys who were capturing human subjects.

options.label: C
options.text: The operation was meant to establish high-frequency radar defense networks around North America and stop future low-altitude reconnaissance.
options.rationale: The 1947 Roswell crash was not an accidental navigation failure caused by human Scalar Wave Radar towers.

options.label: D
options.text: The strategic aim was to break the Custodians' control matrix timeline by forcing advanced solid-state technology into human civilization.
options.rationale: The Roswell Checkmate was the strategic downfall engineered by the Anakim Giants in 1947 to break the Custodians' control matrix timeline by forcing advanced solid-state technology into human civilization.

questions.hint: Consider how introducing miniaturized electronics affected the timeline of the farm's controllers.
